full_judgment: "The land with structures on plot Nos. 12446, 12447 and 1244 is definitely situated within the periphery of Sultanpur bazar within the meaning of section 2(12) of the said Act and it is not a retain able class of land under section 20(2) of the East Bengal State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 read with Ordinance No. 12 of 1960."
